categories.main_business_segments: Ginlong Technologies primarily operates in the renewable energy sector, focusing on two core business segments: photovoltaic (PV) inverters and distributed photovoltaic power generation. The company develops, manufactures, sells, and services string inverters including grid-tied and energy storage inverters. Additionally, through its subsidiary Jinlang Smart Energy, it engages in the development, construction, and operation of distributed PV power stations, serving both commercial/industrial and residential markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as SiC semiconductor materials, high-efficiency magnetic components, DSPs, and intelligent control algorithms to enhance inverter efficiency, reaching up to 99.1%. It has developed proprietary technologies including fire hazard DC arc detection, multi-inverter anti-resonance control, intelligent maximum power point tracking (MPPT), high-frequency switching inverter technology, and virtual synchronous machine technology. Production is managed through a comprehensive ERP system with strict quality control and certifications including ISO9001, ISO14001, and occupational health and safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ginlong serves photovoltaic system integrators, EPC contractors, installation companies, and end investors including industrial, commercial, and residential users. Its products are used in distributed PV systems and large-scale ground-mounted solar power stations. The company’s customers are primarily PV power station investors and operators, with sales channels including direct sales domestically and internationally, supported by localized marketing and service teams.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with a strong presence in China, which accounts for over half of its revenue, and significant sales in overseas markets including Europe, Australia, the Americas, and Southeast Asia. It has subsidiaries and sales/service offices in key regions such as Australia, Hong Kong, the USA, and Vietnam, supporting its global market expansion and localized customer service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ginlong Technologies operates primarily in the midstream segment of the photovoltaic industry supply chain as a manufacturer of core PV system components, specifically string inverters. It also extends downstream into distributed PV power generation through its investment, development, and operation of solar power stations, thus integrating vertically within the renewable energy value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation as its core competitive advantage, investing heavily in R&D to develop high-efficiency, reliable, and cost-effective inverter products. It maintains multiple national-level research platforms and collaborates with academic and research institutions. Key R&D directions include enhancing inverter efficiency, expanding energy storage solutions, adapting products to regional market needs, and advancing smart grid integration technologies. The company also focuses on digital transformation and quality management to improve operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.
categories.revenue_model: Ginlong generates revenue primarily through the sale of photovoltaic string inverters and related products. It also earns income from the development, construction, and operation of distributed photovoltaic power stations by selling generated electricity to end users and grid companies. Additionally, the company provides comprehensive residential PV system services, including design, installation, operation, and maintenance, generating service revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ginlong is positioned as a leading global manufacturer of string inverters with a strong brand presence domestically and internationally. It is recognized as a Tier 1 global PV inverter manufacturer and has received multiple industry awards for innovation and brand strength. The company competes with other major inverter manufacturers in the renewable energy sector, leveraging its technological leadership, global footprint, and integrated business model to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Ginlong reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 6.54 billion, representing a 7.23% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 691 million, a decrease of 11.32% compared to the previous year. The company’s total assets stood at over RMB 21 billion, with a steady growth trajectory supported by increased sales in distributed PV power generation and energy storage inverters. R&D investment increased by 23%, reflecting a commitment to innovation-driven growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ginlong emphasizes high product efficiency, reliability, and safety as its key value propositions, with inverter efficiencies reaching up to 99.1% and advanced safety features like AI-based DC arc detection. Its products offer wide input voltage ranges and multiple MPPT channels for flexible system configuration, enhancing energy yield. The company’s integrated approach combining inverter manufacturing with distributed PV power station development provides customers with comprehensive, high-quality green energy solutions. Its global brand recognition and extensive service network further differentiate it in the competitive renewable energy market.
